card.name: Words just before member states
card.fires_on: Small words (if, the, to, their, amongst, new) that come right before a mention of states or nations as members of a union or treaty. Seen in texts on constitutions, congressional apportionment, and international agreements.

modes.label: Before member states
modes.description: Linking word or the word member itself, right before 'states' in treaty or tribunal talk.
modes.example: Furthermore, ITLOS only functions<< if>> member states are willing to submit their differences

modes.label: Before the States in US constitutional text
modes.description: Small word like the, to or their just before 'States' meaning the US states.
modes.example: Representatives and direct Taxes shall be apportioned among<< the>> several States which may be included within this

modes.label: Before nations in climate treaties
modes.description: Small word before developing or industrialized nations in treaty talk.
modes.example: This has been traditionally interpreted to mean that<< the>> industrialized nations of Europe and North America

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting member and membership words, as in member states.
card.plain: It fires on small words right before the text names states or nations belonging to a union, treaty or constitution.
